units.account: Col. Aubry had no new order; it was still on its way. He kept his line where it stood. When an enemy column came onto the bridge and its head neared the south half of the span, he opened fire by volleys at about 170 m, and the column stopped short.

Col. Delacroix fired a few volleys at the column on the bridge. When the order to shift west came at minute 14, he took his time breaking line, as is his way. He formed column and crossed the road behind the 1st, and is still on the move, not yet in line, as the turn ends.
units.departure: The order came at minute 14, with only six minutes left. The engine placed the battalion in line at (1820,1700), which is not behind the 1st Battalion at all. It has crossed the road only to (2010,1790), still in column, and will finish forming line behind the 1st, west of the road, facing the bridge next turn.

units.account: Maj. Verneuil watched the enemy column come onto the bridge and itched to charge. But it never cleared the span, and he would not ride into a defile under musketry, so he held behind the infantry.

Col. Brandt marched on the bridge at once and pushed his column onto the span. He seized the north end and the middle of the crossing. As the head passed the centre it came under volleys from a battalion in line on the south bank. He halted it there, his front ranks returning fire, and he holds the bridge while waiting for support to carry the far end.
Col. Hartmann had no new orders, so he held his column in place and rested his men.
Maj. von Reiter had no orders and held his squadron where it stood.

summary: Turn 2 (20-40). Red's Vanguard Battalion received its order to seize the bridge at minute 3. It marched down the high road and reached the north end around minute 8, then pushed onto the span. As its head passed the middle it came within musket range of Blue's 1st Battalion on the south bank and was halted by volleys. It ends holding the north end and the middle of the bridge (centre about 2050,1460), having lost 28 men to Blue's 9. Blue's 2nd Battalion fired briefly. Then its order to shift behind the 1st, west of the road, arrived at minute 14, and its cautious colonel had only begun the move: it is in column at (2010,1790) and will form line facing the bridge next turn. Blue's order for the 1st to advance to the bridge's south end is still on the road, due turn 3 minute 6, and was not acted on. Blue's cavalry held behind the line. Red's Line Battalion and hussars held without orders. The bridge is contested: Red holds the span and Blue covers the south exit.
